description: Use this when the connected user asks to change their AIApply job preferences — target roles, locations, work types, experience, salary, excluded companies, the daily limit, or how applications are submitted. Nothing here can change them: this returns the link to the page where the user changes them themselves. Read the current values with get_auto_apply_preferences first, tell the user what would change, then give them this link. Never say a preference has been changed. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one.
name: open_auto_apply_preferences

preferences_url.description: The AIApply page where the user changes their preferences.

title: Open AIApply job preferences
